audit_entry.title: Align configuration loading with nested structure and add dependency checks
audit_entry.description: Updated config loading to support both flat and nested YAML structures with comprehensive fallbacks, and added runtime dependency validation.

issues_addressed.issue: Config loading expects flat keys while repo uses nested structure
issues_addressed.impact: Configuration not properly loaded from repository config.yaml

issues_addressed.issue: No fallback handling for missing or malformed config values
issues_addressed.impact: Application failure when config is incomplete
Silent failures when required tools are missing

changes: Added fallback support for both flat and nested config keys using yq
Updated all config loading with // fallback operators
Integrated TEMP_DIR loading with performance.temp_directory fallback
Enhanced validation to use same fallback pattern
Added distro-specific installation hints for missing dependencies

key_improvements.description: Configuration now works with both '.screenshot_format' and '.screenshot.format' patterns
Every config value has sensible defaults preventing application crashes
Runtime check for grim, slurp, wf-recorder, ffmpeg, yq with helpful installation hints
Checks for optimization tools only when optimize_by_default is enabled

testing_notes: Test with repository config.yaml using nested structure
Test with legacy flat config structure
Test dependency check warnings when tools missing
Verify all config variables properly exported and accessible

backward_compatibility.breaking_changes: None - supports both old flat and new nested configurations
backward_compatibility.migration_path: Existing configs continue to work; new nested format preferred

concerns: Dependency warnings might be verbose on systems missing optional tools
mitigations: Optional tools only warned when optimization enabled

metadata.estimated_impact: High - resolves config compatibility and prevents runtime failures
